entries.jsdocSummary: Points that carry a wall-clock time of day.

entries.jsdocSummary: Date fields plus any subset of time fields (missing time fields are zero).

entries.name: WallParts

entries.name: WeekRules
entries.signature: export type WeekRules = Readonly<{ startsOn: Weekday; minimalDays: 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7; }>;
entries.jsdocSummary: How weeks are counted. `startsOn` is the first day of the week; `minimalDays` is how many days of January must fall in week 1 (ISO: Monday, 4).

entries.name: ZonedDateTime
entries.signature: export type ZonedDateTime = Temporal.ZonedDateTime;
entries.jsdocSummary: An exact moment projected into an IANA time zone — the everyday scheduling type.

entries.name: durationSchema
entries.signature: export declare function durationSchema(): z.ZodType<Duration, string | Duration>;

entries.name: instantSchema
entries.signature: export declare function instantSchema(): z.ZodType<Instant, string | Instant | Date>;
entries.jsdocSummary: An exact moment: an ISO string with `Z` or an offset, an `Instant`, or a `Date`. Output is an `Instant`.

entries.jsdocSummary: A half-open interval `{ start, end }` whose ends are parsed by `point`. An `end` before `start` is an issue.

entries.name: plainDateSchema
entries.signature: export declare function plainDateSchema(): z.ZodType<PlainDate, string | PlainDate>;
entries.jsdocSummary: A calendar date: `'YYYY-MM-DD'` or a `PlainDate`. Output is a `PlainDate`.

entries.name: plainDateTimeSchema
entries.signature: export declare function plainDateTimeSchema(): z.ZodType<PlainDateTime, string | PlainDateTime>;
entries.jsdocSummary: A zone-less date and time: `'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm[:ss]'` or a `PlainDateTime`. Output is a `PlainDateTime`.

entries.name: timeZoneSchema
entries.signature: export declare function timeZoneSchema(): z.ZodType<string, string>;
entries.jsdocSummary: An IANA time zone id. Output is the canonical id (for example `'europe/bucharest'` becomes `'Europe/Bucharest'`).

entries.signature: export declare function zonedDateTimeSchema(options?: { timeZone?: string; }): z.ZodType<ZonedDateTime, string | ZonedDateTime>;
entries.jsdocSummary: An exact moment in a zone. Without `timeZone` a string must carry a `[Zone]` annotation; with `timeZone` the value is read in (or projected into) that zone.

entries.name: atTime
entries.signature: export declare function atTime(date: PlainDate, time: Partial<TimeParts>, timeZone: string, options?: ZonedOptions): ZonedDateTime;
entries.jsdocSummary: A calendar date at a wall-clock time in a zone.

entries.jsdocSummary: The same instant, shown in another zone.

entries.name: isValidTimeZone

entries.jsdocSummary: Is this a time zone the runtime knows (IANA name or fixed offset)?

entries.name: offset
entries.signature: export declare function offset(value: ZonedDateTime): string;
entries.jsdocSummary: The UTC offset as text, e.g. `+03:00`.

entries.name: offsetMinutes
entries.signature: export declare function offsetMinutes(value: ZonedDateTime): number;
entries.jsdocSummary: The UTC offset in minutes (east positive).

entries.name: reinterpretZone
entries.signature: export declare function reinterpretZone(value: ZonedDateTime, timeZone: string, options?: ZonedOptions): ZonedDateTime;
entries.jsdocSummary: The same wall-clock fields, read as if they were in another zone (the instant changes).
